purpose: Teach: 些細/年中/最期/人前/一夜/ほしく/濃く/くさい

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 些細なことが、年取ると、気になる。
lines.en: Small things start to wear on you more as you get older.
lines.style: Quiet, philosophical opening. Measured pace. A gentle observation, not a complaint. Voice settles lower on the second clause, as if it's something he's noticed in himself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。庭の手入れ、年中、続けないとね。
lines.en: That's true. The garden needs constant attention, year after year.
lines.style: Soft agreement. Knowing tone—she's lived this with him for decades. A slight weariness in the admission, but no bitterness. Matter-of-fact about the work it takes.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お互いの最期、どう迎えるか、話す時期かもな。
lines.en: Maybe it's time we talked about how we each want the end to come.
lines.style: Quieter now. The words come carefully, without urgency. A long pause before speaking, as if he's been sitting with this thought. Gentle despite the weight.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 人前で甘い言葉、苦手だったわね、若い頃から。
lines.en: I was never good with sweet words in front of people, even when I was young.
lines.style: Slight wry smile in the voice. Not deflecting—acknowledging a truth about herself. A touch of self-awareness, maybe a little affection for her own limits. Trailing off softly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 一夜で結論、出せる問題じゃないさ。
lines.en: We're not going to settle something like this in one night.
lines.style: Grounded, almost gentle firmness. A light touch of reality—not harsh, just clear. He's reassuring her without saying so. Steady breath, no rush.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 孫が、おもちゃをほしくなって、せがむわよ。
lines.en: Though the grandkid will probably want some new toy and pester us for it.
lines.style: Warm, slightly exasperated affection. A knowing laugh underneath. The everyday interruptions of life breaking into the heavier moment—she's shifting the air gently.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お茶、濃く淹れすぎたな。
lines.en: I brewed the tea too strong.
lines.style: Self-deprecating observation, almost amused. A quiet realization, like he's just noticed his own small mistake. No frustration, just the gentle noting of imperfection.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 布団、干さないと、くさい感じになるから、明日出すわ。
lines.en: The futon will get musty if I don't hang it out, so I'll do it tomorrow.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, capable. The voice of someone managing small, necessary tasks. Warm and practical—a quiet closing note, returning to the ordinary rhythms of living together.
